competences.description: Attacks the enemy to deal damage that increases according to your MAX HP.
Attacks all enemies 3 times, each attack having a 30% chance to remove one beneficial effect. Absorbs Attack Bar by 15% each when the enemy has no beneficial effects.

The effect activation chance resets after attacking. [Automatic Effect]
